about.lead: We build the tools that let small brands sell online like big ones: their own link, their own look, their own customers. No code, and a free plan to start.
about.story2: So we built a store builder that fits how they actually work: Arabic first, mobile first, cash and online payments, local shipping, and a free plan that only charges when orders come in.
about.p2Body: The Free plan has no subscription and no setup fee, and you pay $0.03 per order. You need a first $5 top-up before you can see orders and send campaigns, and customer order emails need the Order Notifications app at 1 cent per order.
about.p3Body: Arabic interface, prices in EGP for your customers, local payment methods and couriers, support on WhatsApp.
about.f3: per order on the Free plan, never a percentage
about.hiringBody: Help us put more Egyptian brands online.
about.story: Most Egyptian brands start on Instagram and WhatsApp. Orders live in DMs, stock lives in a notebook, and the brand lives on someone else's platform. We started Tallaby to give them a home of their own.
about.story1: Tallaby began as a marketplace connecting shoppers with independent vendors across Egypt. Talking to those vendors every day, we heard the same request: help us sell under our own name.
about.p1Body: Your store carries your name, your colors and your link. Tallaby stays in the background.
about.p4Body: If a feature needs a tutorial, we redesign it. Running a store should feel like using your phone.
